caption: The drawing depicts three main objects on a plain, beige background. At the top center is a colored, detailed rendering of a metal implement, which appears to be made of iron, with a central curved section and a handle attached at both ends to the main body. This object, predominantly gray and brown in color, has a ridged, gear-like edge on one side and a flat, grooved base, suggesting it is some sort of press or stamp. On the left, below the main object, is a monochrome, outlined drawing of a rectangular ticket or card, bordered with a double line, bearing the inscription, “YEAT [YEAR?] BILLS PAID 1886” in uppercase letters. To the right of this card is another simple, monochrome outline of a rectangular object with parallel lines running across its width, giving it a ridged or lined texture. Near the center beneath the main metal object, the name "ALBERT GEUPERT" is printed in small uppercase letters. The composition spaces the colored object prominently at the top, with the two outlined shapes symmetrically arranged on the lower half of the paper.
title: Fluting Iron
